title: Launch an online storefront
summary: When customers will select and purchase products through an online shop. An approved storefront with reconciled test orders, delivery and return paths, and a named operating owner.
outcomes: An approved storefront with reconciled test orders, delivery and return paths, and a named operating owner.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When customers will select and purchase products through an online shop.

parts.title: Define the catalogue and selling territories
parts.guidance: List products, variants, stock sources, customer locations and fulfillment owners. Record restrictions and unresolved product information before preparing listings or committing to a selling channel.

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Approve commercial and customer obligations
parts.guidance: The responsible owner and advisers review selling permissions, pricing, tax treatment, delivery promises and returns. Resolve unsupported territories and products before approving checkout availability.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

parts.title: Prepare the storefront and order configuration
parts.guidance: Prepare product content, inventory rules, shipping options and support instructions in a draft environment. Keep actual customer information and payment credentials outside public source files.

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Configure the approved selling and payment accounts
parts.guidance: An authorized operator applies the reviewed account settings and permissions. Record who controls payment access and keep the storefront unpublished while testing the order lifecycle.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

approval.scope: Configure the approved selling and payment accounts

parts.title: Verify the complete order journey
parts.guidance: The responsible operators check purchase, failed payment, cancellation, fulfillment, refund and stock reconciliation using safe test cases. Document failures and require fixes before exposing the affected journey.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

parts.title: Authorize publication and operational handover
parts.guidance: The owner approves the final store and public terms. An authorized operator publishes it, confirms production configuration and hands support, fulfillment and reconciliation duties to named owners.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

verify.how: An approved storefront with reconciled test orders, delivery and return paths, and a named operating owner.

notes.text: Operational draft. Source checked on 2026-10-30. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance, certification or completed execution is claimed. The source context is provider operational example. Resolve applicable law and expert review before external action.
